item.title: Trump claims victory on affordability despite public anxieties
item.description: President Trump celebrates strong stock market and job growth, but most Americans disapprove of his handling of the economy amid ongoing affordability concerns.

item.title: Milwaukee-area home sales fall 10% as prices jump in January
item.description: Milwaukee-area home sales fell nearly 10% in January 2026 while median prices surged 12.9%, as low inventory and high demand kept the market tight.

item.title: The one industry powering the U.S. labor market
item.description: Health care and social assistance accounted for 95% of US job additions in January 2025, making it the dominant force in the labor market amid slow growth elsewhere.

item.title: Milwaukee building tied to convicted felon to become venue
item.description: A Milwaukee office building once tied to convicted felon Kay Yang will be redeveloped into an events venue after investors won a $2.4M fraud judgment.

item.title: Environment Minnesota finds microplastics in state’s water
item.description: A new report finds microplastics in every Minnesota water sample tested, raising concerns about pollution, public health, and long-term environmental risks.

item.title: UW Athletic Hall of Fame display moving to well-known spot
item.description: The University of Wisconsin is relocating its Athletic Hall of Fame display to a high-traffic site near the Kohl Center, boosting visibility and access.

item.title: First C-Level Award honorees announced
item.description: These awards celebrate top corporate executives who consistently demonstrate remarkable leadership skills, integrity, vision and community engagement.

item.title: Insurer tops hiring goals on $500M Milwaukee project
item.description: Northwestern Mutual exceeded Milwaukee hiring goals for small, disadvantaged businesses and residents on its $500M downtown office renovation.

item.title: Lake Minnetonka apartments sell for $20.4M
item.description: Minnetonka Edgewater Luxury Apartments in Spring Park sold for $20.4 million, or about $249,000 per unit, with an assumed low-rate mortgage.

item.title: Minnesota order aims to speed air, water permit reviews
item.description: Executive order targets faster air, water and wetland permits, adding online applications, AI tools and two-stage reviews to cut delays for projects.
